author: Mark Dietrich
title: SG Americas Securities LLC Trims Stake in Apple (AAPL)
text:
Tweet 
SG Americas Securities LLC lowered its holdings in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 70.1% in the 4th quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 162,959 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 382,904 shares during the quarter. SG Americas Securities LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $27,578,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. 
Other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also added to or reduced their stakes in the company. Woodstock Corp grew its stake in shares of Apple by 0.6% during the 4th quarter. Woodstock Corp now owns 61,147 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $10,348,000 after acquiring an additional 355 shares during the period. Field & Main Bank bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter valued at approximately $5,017,000. Pinnacle Advisory Group Inc. grew its stake in shares of Apple by 10.3% during the 4th quarter. Pinnacle Advisory Group Inc. now owns 17,321 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,931,000 after acquiring an additional 1,614 shares during the period. Advisors Capital Management LLC grew its stake in shares of Apple by 10.3% during the 4th quarter. Advisors Capital Management LLC now owns 102,257 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $17,305,000 after acquiring an additional 9,587 shares during the period. Finally, Lenox Wealth Management Inc. grew its stake in shares of Apple by 3.0% during the 4th quarter. Lenox Wealth Management Inc. now owns 17,532 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,967,000 after acquiring an additional 514 shares during the period. 61.35% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. 
In related news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, April 13th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201 in the last three months. Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. AAPL has been the subject of a number of recent research reports. UBS set a $190.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, January 5th. Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and issued a $205.00 price target (up from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 23rd. Sanford C. Bernstein downgraded Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and dropped their price target for the stock from $195.00 to $170.00 in a research note on Friday, February 2nd. HSBC set a $204.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, January 30th. Finally, Vetr upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $184.49 price target for the company in a research note on Monday, March 5th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock presently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $203.15.
AAPL opened at $165.72 on Monday. Apple has a 12-month low of $141.85 and a 12-month high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. The firm has a market cap of $840,865.50, a PE ratio of 17.99, a PEG ratio of 1.26 and a beta of 1.25. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company earned $3.36 EPS. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities analysts expect that Apple will post 11.3 EPS for the current year. Apple Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
